_note: One prompt per style. {subject} = hardware/tab description. All original: no logos, characters or brand names. 'letter' = title lettering style (see lettering.py).
template_tail: Composition: the subject is large and close-up on the RIGHT side of the image, filling the right 45 percent, slightly cropped by the right edge; the left half shows only the softer, darker background of the same scene. One seamless full-bleed scene edge to edge, no split panels, no borders, no frames. Ultra detailed, sharp focus, high contrast, rich color. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no people, no characters, no watermark.

synthwave-drive.name: Synthwave Drive
synthwave-drive.prompt: Retro 1980s synthwave scene: {subject}, on a glowing magenta neon grid floor, huge striped orange-to-pink sunset sun on the horizon, purple starry sky, chrome reflections, neon pink and cyan rim light.

arcade-room.prompt: Cinematic photo inside a dark 1980s arcade at night: {subject}, glowing CRT screens in the background, purple and blue ambient light, cosmic patterned carpet, shallow depth of field.
